import json
listing = currentProgram.getListing()
regions = [("140af02e2","140af03b0"),("140af03b0","140af03f0")]
out = {}
for name,(s,e) in regions:
    start = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress(s)
    end = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress(e)
    dis = []
    addr = start
    while addr.compareTo(end) < 0:
        inst = listing.getInstructionAt(addr)
        if inst is None:
            addr = addr.add(1); continue
        dis.append("%s  %s" % (inst.getAddress(), inst))
        addr = inst.getMinAddress().add(inst.getLength())
    out[name] = dis
print(json.dumps(out))
